description: Mark and his wife Cathryn have lived in Lebanon, CT, for 37 years. A US Navy veteran, Mark served on a nuclear submarine in New London and later earned degrees in biology and public health. He retired from the State Department of Energy & Environmental Protection (DEEP) after a career in emergency response. Locally, Mark has served as Lebanon’s Emergency Management Director and currently serves on the Board of Selectmen. He is a dedicated supporter of law enforcement, fire, and military...
